simulations.description: PC National simulations for the NCP reform modelling, one row per results tab: the PC's scenario code and names, the sectors shocked, the scenario text (shocks, separated by ' | '), the variant (central, or a lower or higher bound test), and the published macroeconomic results and real GSP by state, as published. L1's real GSP block appears to be the L2 simulation's (AUST 0.386 against L1's real GDP of 0.192): do not use L1's state results. Column labels: real_gdp = Real GDP; real_consumption = Real consumption; real_investment = Real investment; real_government_consumption = Real government consumption; export_volumes = Export volumes; import_volumes = Import volumes; real_wages = Real wages; rate_of_return_on_capital = Rate of return on capital; employment = Employment; capital_stock = Capital stock; nominal_exchange_rate = Nominal exchange rate; gdp_deflator = GDP deflator; consumer_price_index = Consumer price index; export_price_index = Export price index; import_price_index = Import price index; terms_of_trade = Terms of trade; rental_price_of_capital = Rental price of capital; investment_price_index = Investment price index; government_price_index = Government price index; real_gsp_nsw = Real GSP, NSW; real_gsp_vic = Real GSP, VIC; real_gsp_qld = Real GSP, QLD; real_gsp_sa = Real GSP, SA; real_gsp_wa = Real GSP, WA; real_gsp_tas = Real GSP, TAS; real_gsp_nt = Real GSP, NT; real_gsp_act = Real GSP, ACT; real_gsp_aust = Real GSP, AUST; gsp_gap = real GSP (AUST) minus real GDP, derived (a large gap flags a tab to check; see L1).

rows.long_name: Liberalise and standardise commercial zoning rules and review planning requirements to ensure they do not distort competition
rows.scenario: Capital productivity increases by 0.1% in the Retail sector
rows.title: B2: Commercial planning and zoning

rows.long_name: Improve contestability and value for money in public procurement
rows.scenario: Removal of rents (2% of expenditures) on all goods and services in government expenditures
rows.sectors: All commodities used in government final consumption expenditure
rows.title: B3: Public procurement

rows.long_name: Improve domestic distribution networks
rows.scenario: Price of imported Motor vehicles and parts decreases by 0.098%
rows.title: B7ice: Distribution networks (internal combustion engines)

rows.long_name: Improve domestic distribution networks
rows.scenario: Removal of all tariffs and increase multifactor productivity (labour and capital) across all industries by 0.06% (representing the removal of the associated compliance costs)
rows.title: B7tar: Distribution networks (tariffs and compliance costs)

rows.long_name: Improve domestic distribution networks
rows.scenario: Removal of all tariffs and increase multifactor productivity (labour and capital) across all industries by 0.09% (representing the removal of the associated compliance costs)

rows.long_name: Improve domestic distribution networks
rows.scenario: Removal of all tariffs and increase multifactor productivity (labour and capital) across all industries by 0.03% (representing the removal of the associated compliance costs)
rows.title: B7tar: Distribution networks (tariffs and compliance costs) (lower estimate)

rows.long_name: Implement forward-looking efficient user charging approaches

rows.long_name: Optimise data availability and sharing to improve competition
